record.title: National securities exchange registration
kv: The system performs exchange functions and uses the registered-exchange route.
New York Stock Exchange LLC (registered or chartered); The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (registered or chartered); Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc. (registered or chartered)
Establish exchange registration and rulebook. Identify membership, products and access requirements.
This is distinct from an ATS; no named exchange is assessed in this route view yet.
New York Stock Exchange LLC: SEC's national-exchange list names New York Stock Exchange LLC as registered under Exchange Act section 6(a).
The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC: SEC's national-exchange list names The Nasdaq Stock Market, while current SEC SRO filings identify the legal entity as The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC.
Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.: SEC's national-exchange list names Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc. as registered under Exchange Act section 6(a).
New York Stock Exchange LLC: SEC Section 6(a) registered national securities exchange. The SEC national-exchange list identifies New York Stock Exchange LLC.
The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC: SEC Section 6(a) registered national securities exchange. SEC's exchange list and current SRO filing record together identify The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC.
Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.: SEC Section 6(a) registered national securities exchange. SEC's current list includes this exact entity.
